source.author: Robert L. Molinari
source.title: Physical oceanographic conditions in the tropical South Atlantic relative to the placement of a grazing OTEC plant

study_area.role: OTEC study area, not current endpoints or a width box

measurement_operators.quantity: Geostrophic component inferred from hydrographic density; component perpendicular to the survey section, spatially averaged between stations.
measurement_operators.caution: Retain prose depth and figure pressure labels separately; no conversion between m and dbar performed. This omits Ekman drift and is not an absolute parcel trajectory.

measurement_operators.quantity: Current vectors relative to the vector at600m; ship navigation was insufficient to determine absolute drift accurately.
The author describes an average of the currents in the upper30m layer.
measurement_operators.caution: Not interchangeable with surface geostrophic flow; this30m support does not establish SECC thickness.

regional_flow_claims.flow_component: eastward surface geostrophic component relative to the declared reference
regional_flow_claims.dates_meaning: Survey-map date bounds, not observation dates for every point or current-wide extrema
regional_flow_claims.band_role: Author-reported regional flow band, not paired flow-normal width edges
Author-reported regional flow band, not paired flow-normal width edges

unresolved_source_discrepancy.decision: Preserve both labels. No automatic date correction, dated-record admission or seasonal playback from this disputed episode.

length_gate.reason: The selected current section and maps describe a local geostrophic flow field over surveyed stations. Neither the OTEC box nor the dynamic-height contour endpoints defines the full named current.
do_not_infer: Do not convert6-8S or6-7S bands into measured widths.
Do not use map-frame20-35W bounds or local contour endpoints as current start/end gates.
Do not join observations from separate cruises into a continuous current axis.
Do not transfer the executive-summary3-5S undercurrent description to the SECC.
Do not treat the600m reference vector or30m drifter support as current thickness.
Do not compute annual minima,maxima or confidence intervals from these regional episodes.
